disclaimer: Local validation only. It checks pipeline syntax, structure and component types. It does not run the orchestrator's submission validation and it is NOT evidence that a pipeline executes. No entry here may be promoted to verified-executed without a dated Expanso Cloud run record.

readiness_vocabulary.invalid-does-not-validate: At least one pipeline variant is rejected by the local validator at the recorded version; see `variants`.
readiness_vocabulary.validated-not-executed: Every pipeline variant passes local validation. Never executed end to end.
readiness_vocabulary.verified-executed: Reserved. Not in use; requires a Cloud run record.

validators.job_spec: expanso-cli job validate --offline -- what the repository CI gate runs; decides `job_spec_accepted`. Acceptance here is NOT semantic validity: it does not check inner component configuration.
